Other versions of this Virtual Modern card: Jedi Levitation (V), Jedi Levitation (V) (Errata). For the Decipher card, see Jedi Levitation.

Jedi Levitation is a Light Interrupt (Used or Lost Interrupt) from Virtual Set 0.

Card Text

USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.

Lore

A Jedi can adjust the Force within and around an object, causing it to move as the Jedi wills.


Notes

Source occurrence

  • Original (Jedi Levitation (V)): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018[2] (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Jedi Levitation”. Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.”
  • Source publication (this page): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022[3]. What changed: the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Jedi Levitation”. Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.”
  • Errata (Jedi Levitation (V) (Errata)): PC card image recorded in the repository on 12 December 2022[4]. What changed: the game text was rewritten (compare the texts below); the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Jedi Levitation”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, choose: Take that card into hand. OR Cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to take a character into hand from Lost Pile.”
